items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: And one of the fellas I remember very well, he used to call him Sand Paper George.

ctx.x: It has a slide. Oh yes, yes, yes.

Well there used to be a group that used to make all these fish fries around that particular time. And one of the fellas I remember very well, he used to call him Sand Paper George. Oh I've heard of him. The thing about it, he used to give the group rhythm, you know, he had pieces of sandpaper, he used to rub them together and you'd be surprised at the type of rhythm you would get from it. And I had noticed him in several places, you know, even sometimes the local spots, you know, in the barrooms, and he'd go in…
Maybe he's still around in the city. Maybe we can play.
